title: Common Signals, Spurious Cross-Excitation, and Identification in Multivariate Hawkes Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.19428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multivariate Hawkes models are widely used to measure endogenous interactions in event data, but latent common signals can generate apparent excitation even without structural interaction. We characterize the resulting linear projection and construct stable, nonnegative Hawkes processes that share the mean intensity and Bartlett spectrum of common-signal models despite having different excitation mechanisms. This establishes a concrete form of second-order non-identification. We derive integrated third-order cumulants for Hawkes processes with Cox immigration and establish generic local identification of normalized structural parameters in two- and three-dimensional systems. An exact-equivalence Monte Carlo experiment demonstrates how third-order information can distinguish mechanisms with identical second-order structure, while revealing substantial finite-sample limitations under weak signals. translated_title: 多元Hawkes过程中的共同信号、虚假交叉激发与可识别性
translated_abstract: 多元Hawkes模型被广泛用于测量事件数据中的内生相互作用，但潜在的共同信号即使在没有结构性相互作用的情况下也会产生明显的激发效应。我们刻画了由此产生的线性投影，并构建了稳定的非负Hawkes过程，这些过程尽管具有不同的激发机制，却与共同信号模型拥有相同的平均强度和Bartlett谱。这确立了一种具体的二阶不可识别性形式。我们推导了带Cox移民机制的Hawkes过程的积分三阶累积量，并在二维和三维系统中建立了归一化结构参数的一般局部可识别性。一个精确等价的蒙特卡洛实验展示了三阶信息如何区分具有相同二阶结构的机制，同时揭示了弱信号情形下显著的有限样本局限性。对于一个受限的参数族，我们……
tldr: 本文揭示多元Hawkes过程中潜在共同信号会引发虚假交叉激发并造成二阶矩不可识别，同时证明三阶累积量信息可用于区分激发机制并实现结构参数的可识别性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that latent common signals in multivariate Hawkes processes generate spurious cross-excitation and second-order non-identification, while demonstrating that third-order cumulants can distinguish excitation mechanisms and achieve local identification of structural parameters.
